transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because I've been having this problem with elevators. I mean, I know they aren’t really dangerous, but... when I have to get in one, I just get so scared. It feels like I’m going to be trapped in there, and I just can’t make myself feel normal about it no matter what I tell myself.
Are you also afraid of other places where it might be hard to get out or get help, like buses, trains, crowded stores, or being outside alone?
No, it's really just the elevators. I don't have any problem riding the bus to work or being in a crowded store. It's just... getting into that little box. Everything else is fine.
